corrections.trigger: fix1 snapshots followed symbolic links, so an atomic replacement could remove an originally linked managed entry and rollback could not preserve the original inode or target ownership; absent-file and non-file states were not distinguished by lstat.
corrections.change: Use lstatSync for managed tunnel installation snapshots, reject symbolic links and non-regular entries, and preserve the existing empty snapshot for genuinely absent paths so external creation remains detectable during rollback.

notes: Fix1 changes in launcher/electron/update.cjs and launcher/electron/resumable-download.cjs were retained after direct-caller review; no additional correction was source-backed.
The shared main.cjs lane 5 caller currently awaits async cancelInstall; lane 5 remains responsible for preserving that integration.

The install lock coordinates cooperating installers only; arbitrary external editors can still race by ignoring the lock, and executable plus manifest replacement is not one pairwise filesystem transaction.
No tests, typechecks, scripts, runtime actions, commits, pushes, or delegation were performed.
